claims.content: To define and assign specific access rights (such as New, Edit, Delete, View, Print) to a User Group for various system modules and screens.

goal.raw_text: To define and assign specific access rights (such as New, Edit, Delete, View, Print) to a User Group for various system modules and screens.

claims.content: The system administrator must be logged into the VMUS application.
The user must have the necessary privileges to create and manage User Groups (as implied by the constraint that only the system admin can create User Groups).
The System Administrator needs to create a new User Group or modify the permissions of an existing one.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator needs to create a new User Group or modify the permissions of an existing one.

claims.content: The System Administrator navigates to the 'Security and User Privileges' module.
The system displays the option to create a new User Group or manage existing ones.
The System Administrator selects to create a new User Group or edit an existing one.
If creating a new group, the System Administrator enters the mandatory information: Group Name (selecting from User Group list if applicable), User Name, Password, and Verify Password.
The system validates that the Password and Verify Password values are equal. If they do not match, the system does not save the user information.
The system checks for existing names; it does not allow the creation of a User Group or Individual User with an existing name.

For each Screen Name associated with the User Group, the System Administrator defines the permissions by setting the following flags: New – Allowed / Not Allowed, Edit – Allowed / Not Allowed, Delete – Allowed / Not Allowed, View – Allowed / Not Allowed, Print – Allowed / Not Allowed.
The System Administrator saves the configuration.
The system saves the user information and updates the security settings based on the defined privileges.
